script_text: Stop, Pisces, the heavens are dropping a warning on your doorstep. The cosmos is not speaking in whispers. You are being called to a deeper, urgent truth. Neptune, the water planet, is forming a tense square to your 4th House of Home, destabilizing your sense of emotional safety. This cosmic tension is a direct reminder that your deepest attachments are being challenged. You will attract someone whose presence feels like a sudden downpour on a dry day, but their intentions are genuine. Trust their authenticity, for they are the grounding presence you need right now. Your 10th House of Career is unlocking a new public platform, but only if you stop hiding your authentic talents behind modesty. The universe is sending you a rare opportunity to step into the spotlight without apology. Avoid chasing fleeting illusions, because Neptune's influence can lull you into false peace. Follow for tomorrow's reading to discover what the cosmos has prepared for your next phase.
